stem.text: A driver stops his car in time $t$ by gradually increasing the total braking force on the car. The graph shows the resultant force on the car.

stem.alt: Graph of force (vertical axis) against time (horizontal axis, marked t); a straight line starts at the origin and rises to the right.

stem.text: Which graph shows how the speed of the car will vary during this time?

A.alt: Graph of speed against time (marked t): a curve falling from the vertical axis to the horizontal axis at t.

B.alt: Graph of speed against time (marked t) on a straight line from the vertical axis down to the horizontal axis.

C.alt: Graph of speed against time (marked t): a curve falling from the vertical axis to the horizontal axis at t, with a change of curvature part-way along.

D.alt: Graph of speed against time (marked t): a curve that starts level at the vertical axis and falls to the horizontal axis at t.
